title: 2024 AMC 10A Problem 23
statement:
Integers \(a,\) \(b,\) and \(c\) satisfy

\[ \begin{aligned} ab + c &= 100, \\ bc + a &= 87, \\ ca + b &= 60. \end{aligned} \]

What is \(ab + bc + ca?\)

solutions.text: Subtract the second equation from the first: \((a-c)(b-1)=13.\) Put \(u=a-c\) and \(v=b-1.\) The four possibilities \((u,v)=(1,13),\) \((13,1),\) \((-1,-13),\) and \((-13,-1)\) give, after substitution into \(bc+a=87,\) respectively \(c=\frac{86}{15},\) \(c=\frac{74}{3},\) \(c=-8,\) and \(c=100.\) Only the third is an integer solution of all three original equations: \((a,b,c)=(-9,-12,-8).\) (The last candidate is \((87,0,100),\) which fails \(ca+b=60.\)) Adding the original equations gives \(ab+bc+ca\) \({}+(a+b+c)=247.\) Since \(a+b+c=-29,\) we obtain \(ab+bc+ca\) \(=247-(-29)=276.\) Thus, D is the correct answer.
hints: Add all three equations to relate \(ab + bc + ca\) and \(a + b + c\)
Subtract the first two equations to get \((a-c)(b-1)=13;\) enumerate the four signed factor pairs of \(13\)
